name: BigMouth Prescription Bottle Coffee Mug (12 oz)
seoTitle: Prescription Bottle Coffee Mug for Nurses
metaDescription: A ceramic coffee mug shaped like a prescription pill bottle, a funny gag gift for nurses, pharmacists, and anyone who treats coffee like daily medicine.
summary: A pill bottle shaped mug for the nurse whose coffee is basically a prescription. A funny gag gift that also works for pharmacy friends.
whyItWorks: Coffee as medicine is a joke every nurse has heard, and probably made, during a rough stretch of shifts. A mug that looks like a giant orange pill bottle turns that joke into something they can hold. It gets a reaction in the break room, and coworkers will ask where it came from.

Novelty mugs can be hit or miss, but the medical shape here ties it directly to the recipient's work, so it feels chosen rather than random. It is a strong pick for a white elephant or Secret Santa exchange on a hospital unit, where it will appeal to nurses, pharmacists, and doctors alike. The title notes it is ceramic and dishwasher safe, which helps since it will see daily use. At 12 ounces, it holds a solid cup of coffee for a morning before day shift. Consider adding a bag of beans or a sleeve of their favorite K cups so the prescription comes filled.
goodToKnow: The title lists it as a 12 oz ceramic mug that is dishwasher safe, but check the listing on microwave use.
Look at the listing photos to see the label text, since that carries most of the joke.
It works well for mixed healthcare teams, so it suits unit gift exchanges where you do not know who you will draw.

faq.q: Is this a good white elephant gift for a nursing unit?
faq.a: Yes, it is a crowd pleaser because the medical joke lands with nurses, pharmacists, and doctors. It is easy to wrap and fun to unwrap.

faq.q: Is it suitable for a pharmacist rather than a nurse?
faq.a: It fits pharmacists especially well given the pill bottle design. It is a good shared gift for anyone in healthcare.
